channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Gov. Ivey proclaims Public Schools Week, celebrates gains by students
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey highlighted Alabama's improved national rankings in math and reading while designating a week to honor the state's public schools.

item.title: Monte Sano State Park unveils renovated historic bluff-side cabins
item.description: Officials celebrated the renovation of 14 historic bluff-side cabins and expanded campground amenities during a ribbon-cutting ceremony Friday at Monte Sano State Park.

item.title: Alabama Port Authority launches new initiative, logo
item.description: The Alabama Port Authority on Monday launched a new brand and service platform designed to strengthen the state’s global logistics position.

item.title: Rep. Aderholt to host Passport Fair in Florence
item.description: Representative Robert Aderholt will host a March 9 passport fair in Florence to help North Alabama residents prepare for international travel.

item.title: The Links hosts Annual Links Day at the Capitol
item.description: Leaders from nine Alabama chapters of The Links, Incorporated gather in Montgomery for a day of legislative engagement and community advocacy.

item.title: Manufacture Alabama announces “Coolest Thing Made in Alabama” contest
item.description: Manufacture Alabama opened nominations Monday for its Manufacturing Madness tournament, a bracket-style competition to crown the state’s coolest manufactured product.

item.title: Should Alabama provide no-cost school breakfast? Alabama Arise says yes
item.description: Advocates gathered at the Alabama State Capitol to lobby for a $14 million appropriation to fund breakfast for every public school student.

item.title: Alabama AG urges AMA to disavow hormonal treatments for trans minors
item.description: Alabama is among states threatening consumer protection investigations if the medical group doesn't oppose hormonal treatments for minors.

item.title: Alabama bill would prioritize victim restitution over court fees
item.description: HB481 would require restitution to victims be paid before court fines, fees and costs in Alabama criminal cases.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama women should not fight for reconstruction after cancer
item.description: Our responsibility as lawmakers is straightforward: when a law guarantees care, patients should be able to receive it.
